/* eslint-disable */

/**
 * The SQL value domain this binding crosses (enrahitu spec 032).
 *
 * NULL, INTEGER, REAL and TEXT round-trip. Blobs are deliberately absent: JSON
 * has no byte type and every candidate encoding (base64 string, array of
 * numbers) is ambiguous with a legitimate value of that shape, so guessing one
 * now would become a compatibility promise later. Passing a BLOB column through
 * `query` raises an error naming the column rather than mis-encoding it.
 *
 * Arrays and objects are not SQL values either: serialize them with
 * `JSON.stringify` at the call site, so the column type stays a decision the
 * schema makes rather than one this binding makes for it.
 */
export type SqlValue = string | number | boolean | null

/** One result row, keyed by column name. */
export type SqlRow = Record<string, SqlValue>
